# Synthetic LAZ regression fixtures

These are tiny synthetic point-cloud test fixtures generated by
`scripts/generate-laz-test-fixtures.py`. They contain no customer or uploaded
geometry. The compressed LAZ bytes are versioned as ASCII base64 sidecars; tests
decode them into an OS temporary directory before parsing. The explicit
`.gitignore` exceptions allow only this README and the three named `.b64` files
to be versioned; raw/local fixture files remain ignored.

Regenerate with Python 3 and the optional fixture-writer tools:

```sh
python -m pip install "laspy[lazrs]==2.7.0" "lazrs==0.8.2"
python scripts/generate-laz-test-fixtures.py
```

The test data uses a synthetic EPSG:32610 WKT and metre coordinates. The first
small sample begins at `(500000, 6000000, 100)` and carries intensity,
classification, and RGB values used by `test/laz-node.test.js`.

| File | Format | Points | Decoded size | SHA-256 of decoded LAZ bytes |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `laz12-sample.laz.b64` | LAS 1.2, point format 3 | 4 | 786 bytes | `374cf6ded70f098ac575ebae88f4170ca6659584835778d06f008cf53cc777b5` |
| `laz14-sample.laz.b64` | LAS 1.4, point format 8 | 4 | 995 bytes | `319a5e429c43b7924b30d9da5411dc7c792dcbe6a10cdfeab8c7a6753065dd44` |
| `laz-decimation-200005.laz.b64` | LAS 1.2, point format 3 | 200,005 | 82,014 bytes | `f0a237521e6472dd654c51f82e697d68c0f341344814697b4e866332e2950638` |

The decimation fixture is a deterministic repeated grid that compresses below
the 100 KB regression ceiling while exercising the 200,000-point sampling
floor. LAZ encoding metadata may vary if regenerated with different tool
versions; rerun all LAZ tests and refresh the hashes when changing the writer.
